responses:
The current algorithm already finds an exact shared-edge directed Steiner tree for up to 13 destinations. The main opportunity is to reduce the DP state graph before solving it, then safely extend exact optimization to moderately larger receiver groups. Route pruning preserves every node that can participate in a source-to-destination broadcast path, while removing irrelevant multi-cloud regions that otherwise multiply the Steiner DP work.
